text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, a fan letter arrived for Jungle Pocket.
The neat handwriting on the address conveyed
a sense of earnestness.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Huh! A handwritten letter?
You're really fired up, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter
text_block_list.text:
"—Jungle Pocket bites into her rivals
with sheer power and wild ferocity!"

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter
text_block_list.text: "I went to a racetrack for the first time recently because I wanted to feel your power up close. And after the race—"

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter
text_block_list.text:
"When Pokke-san came back,
she thrust her fist right toward me!
My heart was pounding so fast!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
A fist...? Oh!
This is from back then!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
She draped my towel over her shoulders!
And she couldn't take her eyes off me the whole time!
choice_data_list: I gave them some fan service

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Because they had the exact same look in their eyes as my crew.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens, I'll follow you for life...
That's the look of absolute resolve in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Makes ya wanna deliver for 'em, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter
text_block_list.text: ""I was such a coward. The moment I failed even a little, I'd give up... I hated that part of myself so much.""

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter
text_block_list.text:
"However, watching you strive to be 'the strongest'...
feeling that fighting spirit that never gives up,
I truly thought from the bottom of my heart how cool you are."

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Even if bad things happen,
I won't give up and will keep facing them.
Because I want to become even a little bit like you, Pokke-san."

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter
text_block_list.text:
""It might just be on my own terms, but...
I'll always be your underling!""

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
!
Heh, my lackey, huh...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ain't looking to take on any lackeys, but...
you've got some fiery spirit in ya, I'll give ya that.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
I'm gonna take some writing paper!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking a sheet of stationery from her desk,
she wrote a single, bold sentence in giant letters
using a felt-tip pen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Come watch me run again.
choice_data_list: Is that all you're going to say?
Is that all you're going to say?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I don't need any other words.
There's only one thing for me to do.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I'll show this guy that I'm the strongest!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer,
I'm counting on you for some hardcore training!
